rules.name: File format
rules.why: Amazon takes 3D models as GLB or glTF.
rules.quote: We accept assets in .GLB (binary) and .glTF file formats, along with their corresponding supporting textures.

rules.name: Triangles
rules.why: Amazon refuses models over its triangle limit.

rules.name: Texture size
rules.why: Amazon wants square power-of-two textures from 2048 to 4096 px.
rules.quote: It must be square and power of two, with a final resolution of no larger than 4K (4,096 x 4,096 pixels), and no smaller than 2K (2,048 x 2,048 pixels), on all sides.

rules.name: Texture format
rules.why: Textures must be PNG or JPG inside the file.
rules.quote: We accept texture files in .PNG and .JPG format. We do not accept glTF files with image resources embedded directly in JSON.

rules.name: PBR material
rules.why: Every material needs base colour and metallic-roughness.
rules.quote: All materials are PBR Metal-Rough and PBR-compliant.

rules.name: No extras
rules.why: Amazon refuses files with modifiers, animation, cameras or lights.
rules.quote: Model should not contain modifiers, animation key frames, cameras, or lights.

rules.name: glTF extensions
rules.why: Amazon only accepts a short list of glTF extensions.
rules.quote: Unlisted glTF extensions are not currently supported.

rules.name: Placement
rules.why: Floor products should stand on the ground, centred. Wall and ceiling products differ.
rules.quote: All floor-oriented models are centered at the base of the bottom surface in both the X and Z Axes. The pivot point should be at 0,0,0.

rules.name: Single-sided materials
rules.why: Double-sided materials cost render time and can hide errors.

rules.name: File size
rules.why: Advice from third parties, not Amazon's page: keep files under 5 MB.

rules.name: Run the Khronos glTF Validator
rules.why: Amazon expects files without validator errors.
rules.quote: The Khronos Group glTF-Validator tool must be used to check that files meet technical requirements.
